description.value: Willow View Farms is a family-owned U-pick apple orchard and farm market in Abbotsford's Fraser Valley, celebrating over 32 years of selling produce directly from the farm. Cyclists can pick their own apples, pears, and plums in season, or buy pre-picked fruit, fresh-pressed cider, potatoes, jams, and other seasonal goods from the country store. Set against views of Mount Baker and just off Highway 1, it makes for a scenic and restorative detour on a Fraser Valley route.
